name: Energy Search
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Energy Swatter
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose an Energy card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Hole-Digging Shovel
rules: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Jacinthe
rules: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Psychic Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Judge
rules: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Lumiose City
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends.
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.

name: Naveen
rules: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. Before drawing cards, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. (If you can't draw any cards in this way, you can't use this card.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Lumiose Galette
rules: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Pokémon Catcher
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Potion
rules: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Rosa's Encouragement
rules: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.  Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Tarragon
rules: Put up to 4 in any combination of Fighting Pokémon and Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Growing Grass Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Grass Energy. The Grass Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.

name: Rocky Fighting Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Fighting Energy. Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the Fighting Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

name: Telepathic Psychic Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Psychic Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to a Psychic Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Kakuna

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Beedrill ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rumbling Bees
attacks.text: This attack does 110 damage for each of your Beedrill and Beedrill ex in play.

name: Weedle

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Braixen

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Litleo
flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Quilladin

attacks.name: Leafy Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Grass Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Transfer
attacks.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Fennekin

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Delphox

abilities.name: Flaring Magic
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Energized Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to all Pokémon.

flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Chespin
flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Chomp Whole
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no Retreat Cost, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Chesnaught

abilities.name: Needly Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Impound
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Flames of Revival
attacks.text: Put up to 3 Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Mega Pyroar ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Ferocious Bellow
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 50 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Fiery Big Bang
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Golisopod

attacks.name: Critical Slash
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Summoning Jutsu
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Mareep

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Froakie

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Delibird

attacks.name: Pleasing Present
attacks.text: Each player may attach up to 3 Basic Energy cards from their hand to their Pokémon in any way they like. Your opponent does this first.

flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

name: Keldeo

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle filling its body with power and changing its form.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

name: Mega Greninja ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Mortal Shuriken
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may discard a Basic Water Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ninja Spinner
attacks.text: You may put a Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand and have this attack do 80 more damage.

name: Avalugg

attacks.name: Iceberg Breaker
attacks.text: Discard the top 6 cards of your deck, and this attack does 60 damage for each Basic Water Energy card you discarded in this way.

flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Octillery

attacks.name: Jet of Ink
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips 2 coins. If either of them is tails, that attack doesn't happen.

attacks.name: Tantrum
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It's nature's cleaner-it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Synchro Pulse
abilities.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, attacks used by this Pokémon do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Flashing Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Flashing Bolt.

flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Deoxys

attacks.name: Psy Protection
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon that have an Ability.

flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Emolga

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sky Return
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Tricky Steps
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Espurr

attacks.name: Buddy Attack
attacks.text: If you played Emma from your hand during this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

name: Phantump

abilities.name: Spiteful Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Choose a card in your hand that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. If you do, place 2 damage counters on the Pokémon you evolved in this way. You can't use this Ability during your first turn.

flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Deoxys

attacks.name: Genome Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Deoxys

attacks.name: Psyspeed
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Mega Floette ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Gentle Light
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Eternity Bloom
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 4 Basic Psychic Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Disconnect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

name: Deoxys

attacks.name: Psyspear
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant

attacks.name: Cursed Roots
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Energy can't be attached from your opponent's hand to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Overwhelming Pain
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

name: Gourgeist ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Horrifying Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Ghostly Touch
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Trials and Trip-ulations
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Transformation Tome cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

flavorText: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

name: Donphan

attacks.name: No Reprieve
attacks.text: During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Smashing Headbutt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Donphan is normally a calm Pokemon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

name: Xerneas

attacks.name: Geo Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Smash Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Claydol

attacks.name: Devolution Ray
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Stunky
flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Continuous Spin
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Qwilfish

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavorText: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokemon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

name: Zubat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Crobat

abilities.name: Nighttime Maneuvers
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a card. Shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.

attacks.name: Poison Sound Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Garbodor

abilities.name: Gloomy Garbage
abilities.text: Attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon that has a Pokémon Tool attached do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Golbat

attacks.name: Covert Flight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

flavorText: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Krookodile ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Strong Bite
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 140 more damage.

name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Mega Gallade ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Gale Slash
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 150 more damage.

name: Ferrothorn

abilities.name: Startling Drop
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon is discarded from your deck by an effect of an attack or Ability from your opponent's Pokémon, or by an effect of your opponent's Item or Supporter cards, discard the top 8 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Special Whip
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Goodra

abilities.name: Slimy Sliding
abilities.text: When your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, Energy for its Retreat Cost is not discarded, and they don't switch Pokémon. The effect of Slimy Sliding doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

flavorText: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Goomy

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body punches or kicks from its enemies slide right off it.

name: Tauros

attacks.name: Target Together
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play that has "Tauros" in its name. This attack does 50 damage to the chosen Pokémon for each heads. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

name: Metang

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Cobalion ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metal Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Move any amount of Metal Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Power Tackle
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokemon sprays liquid poison to take down prey that approach unawares.

name: Beldum
flavorText: They communicate with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Metagross

attacks.name: Bounce Back
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Metallic Hammer
attacks.text: You may discard 3 Metal Energy from this Pokémon and have this attack do 150 more damage.

flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Mega Dragalge ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Corrosive Liquid
attacks.text: Discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pernicious Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, place 16 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

name: Patrat

abilities.name: Watchful Eye
abilities.text: Damage counters on each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be moved to other Pokémon.

flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog

attacks.name: Snap Inspection
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If any of them are heads, your opponent reveals their hand. For each heads, choose a card you find there and shuffle it into your opponent's deck.

flavorText: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Minccino

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: These Pokemon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Adversity Policy
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has Weakness to your opponent's Active Pokémon's type, is in the Active Spot, and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 3 cards.

name: Special Red Card
rules:
You can use this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 3 cards.

name: Cinccino ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Smooth Coat
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Energized Slap
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

name: Roxie's Performance
rules: During your opponent's next turn, their Poisoned Pokémon can't retreat. (This includes newly Poisoned Pokémon.)

name: Ange Floette
rules:
You can put this card into play only if you discard a Prism Tower in play, and you can put this card into play during the same turn you play Prism Tower.
Each Mega Floette ex in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +150 HP.

name: Emma
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you draw a card for each Pokémon you find there.

name: Great Haul Net
rules:
Choose 1 or both:
• Shuffle up to 3 Water Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
• Shuffle up to 3 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

name: AZ's Tranquility
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you moved a Pokémon ex to your Bench in this way, heal 80 damage from that Pokémon.

name: Philippe
rules: Attach up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Metal Pokémon.

name: Prism Tower
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard 2 cards from their hand in order to draw a card.

name: Transformation Tome
rules:
You must play 2 Transformation Tome cards at once. (This effect works one time for 2 cards.)
 
Choose a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

name: Bubbly Water Energy
rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Water Energy.

The Water Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

name: Nitro Fire Energy
rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Fire Energy.
 
If this card is discarded by an effect of an attack used by the Fire Pokémon this card is attached to, put this card into your hand after attack damage and effects.

name: Magnetic Metal Energy
rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Metal Energy.

The Metal Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost.

name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Jumbo Ice Cream
rules: Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokémon that has 3 or more Energy attached.

name: Surfing Beach
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may switch their Active Water Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Water Pokémon.

name: Tool Scrapper
rules: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.

name: Tropius

attacks.name: Fruity Aroma
attacks.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, and you may reveal any number of Pokémon you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Grubbin

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It spits sticky threads and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

name: Fomantis

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavorText: Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.

name: Lurantis ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Lively Cutter
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 200 more damage.

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Poltchageist

abilities.name: Hide 'n' Sneak
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Furtive Drop
attacks.text: Place 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha

abilities.name: Hide 'n' Sneak
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Matcha Spin
attacks.text: If you have 6 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, place 4 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Heatran

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Lava Wall
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Burned Pokémon.

flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross- shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Sizzlipede

attacks.name: Controlled Burn
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Mega Delphox ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Trick Portal
attacks.text: Look at the top 9 cards of your deck, and you may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Eerie Glow
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

name: Centiskorch

attacks.name: Controlled Burn
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Best Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

name: Armarouge

attacks.name: Flame Legion
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any Fire Energy attached.

flavorText: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Seaking

attacks.name: Hydro Jet
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Wailord ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Falling Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Relicanth

attacks.name: Fossil Beatdown
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has "Antique" in its name.

flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Popplio
flavorText: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try to help.

name: Primarina

abilities.name: Enriching Melody
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Return
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavorText: Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to behold on moonlit nights when it sings in front of the colony it leads.

name: Vikavolt

attacks.name: Quick Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Giga Railgun
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has no Voltaic Lightning Energy attached, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Electrike

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. This Pokémon's whole body gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Finizen

attacks.name: Draining Fin
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin

attacks.name: Knuckle Justice
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 200 more damage.

flavorText: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

name: Manectric

attacks.name: Flashing Barrier
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Evolution Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: As it digests fallen leaves, it generates and stores electricity, which it can discharge from the tips of its jaws.

name: Mega Zeraora ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Thunderous Fist
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage for each Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zepto Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Miraidon

abilities.name: Photon Cord
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: All-You-Can-Yeet
attacks.text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand.

flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Slowbro

attacks.name: All Out
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 160 more damage.

flavorText: An attached Shellder won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of Slowbro's tail.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Banette

abilities.name: Hide 'n' Sneak
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Puppet Pull
attacks.text: You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: A doll bore a grudge over being junked, and it became a Pokémon. It seeks the child that disowned it.

name: Spiritomb

attacks.name: Spiritual End
attacks.text: If you have 13 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and quadruple the number of damage counters on each of them.

flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Jynx

attacks.name: Intense Kiss
attacks.text: At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard the Defending Pokémon and all attached cards.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Lampent

attacks.name: Spreading Light
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Lampent and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Lampent appears at the moment of death and promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

name: Mega Slowbro ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Shellnado Spin
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Shuppet

abilities.name: Hide 'n' Sneak
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

flavorText: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice-or so it's said. It's very active at night.

name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Vengeful Anchor
attacks.text: If you have 4 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, this attack does 140 more damage.

flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Mega Chandelure ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Binding Flame
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Phantom Maze
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

name: Annihilape

abilities.name: Durable Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Ghostly Blow
attacks.text: Place 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Marshadow

attacks.name: Shadowy Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

flavorText: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

name: Primeape
flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Rampardos ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Destructive Headbutting
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rowdy Hammer
attacks.text: During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 150 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Cranidos

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavorText: Cranidos toughen up their already sturdy heads by headbutting one another.

attacks.name: Battle Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Gaia Impact
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Mega Darkrai ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dusk Raid
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 110 more damage.

attacks.name: Abyss Eye
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, it is Knocked Out.

name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Bone Sniper
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Special Energy attached. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

name: Malamar

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Brain Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't Confused, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Morpeko ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Wheely Draw
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

attacks.name: Hangry Blaster
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

name: Inkay

attacks.name: Procurement
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokemon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul

attacks.name: Skill Thief
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, choose an attack from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play and use it as this attack.

flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Mabosstiff

attacks.name: Plunging Headbutt
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Maschiff
flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Zarude

attacks.name: Overhead Throw
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Shadowy Whip
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any Shadowy Darkness Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokemon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokemon of the forest fear it.

name: Chi-Yu

attacks.name: Whirling Envy
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

flavorText: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Bastiodon

abilities.name: Ancient Bulwark
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to each of your Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have 2 or less Energy attached.

flavorText: Bastiodon live in herds. When assaulted by enemies, they line up side by side and use their hard faces to block attacks.

name: Skarmory

attacks.name: Steel Cutter
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 40 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

flavorText: Because it nests in bramble bushes, the feathers of its chicks grow hard from being scratched by thorns.

name: Shieldon

attacks.name: Smithereen Smash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. It's thought that Shieldon had few enemies thanks to its sturdy face.

name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Mirror Attack
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Metal Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavorText: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.

name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Metal Block
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks from Evolution Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Mega Excadrill ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Undermine
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Maximum Drilling
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 130 more damage.

name: Pikipek

attacks.name: Double Stab
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won't hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Antique Armor Fossil
rules:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.
 
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

abilities.name: Protective Armor
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, all of your Pokémon take 10 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

name: Bombirdier

attacks.name: Challenging Delivery
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Silvally

abilities.name: Call a Buddy
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have no cards in your hand, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Toucannon

abilities.name: Aerial Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Draw a card.

attacks.name: Feather Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

flavorText: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.

name: Antique Skull Fossil
rules:
Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.
 
At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

abilities.name: Spiny Skull
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

name: Fossil Quarry
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for up to 2 Item cards that have "Antique" in their name and put them onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck.

name: Gladion's Final Battle
rules:
You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.
During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V_atk, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Backtrack Badge
rules: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack of the Colorless Pokémon this card is attached to, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again.

name: Dark Bell
rules: Both Active non-Darkness Pokémon are now Confused.

name: Gwynn
rules: Discard up to 2 Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your hand, and draw 3 cards for each card you discarded in this way. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V_atk, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Jett
rules: Draw a card for each of your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play.

name: Misty's Vitality
rules: Search your deck for up to 4 Basic Water Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.

name: Rust Syndicate Grunt
rules:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.

Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Tremendous Bomb
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to isn't a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, is in the Active Spot, and takes 240 or more damage from an attack from your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this card.

name: Voltaic Lightning Energy
rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Lightning Energy.
 
Attacks used by the Lightning Pokémon this card is attached to do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Shadowy Darkness Energy
rules:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Darkness Energy.
 
As long as the Darkness Pokémon this card is attached to is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to it by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Brave Bangle
rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V_atk, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

name: Crushing Hammer
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

name: Iron Defender
rules: During your opponent's next turn, all of your Metal Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes new Pokémon that come into play.)

abilities.name: Binding Flame
abilities.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Phantom Maze
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
